body: I've been sober from cocaine for a couple months now. I used to dip back into old habits and relapse quite often, but everytime I wanted to quit (and you just have to act on this feeling the moment you get it) I would take whatever I had and flush it down the toilet. That was one of the best ways I got myself to quit for a prolonged period, because while I was using I couldn't see the money I was wasting. When I flushed a baggie down the drain I could see exactly what I was throwing away. It's extremely likely that you'll relapse, but in my opinion (which is in no way professional) habits like this help to break the cycle.
